learning_outcomes.text: Select an appropriate mathematical modelling tool
Model a problem and apply the most appropriate tools to solve or optimise it
Interpret the results to make a better management/business decision

syllabus_topics: Mathematical Programming: Modelling problems in mathematical programming
Solving operational/management problems using mathematical programming techniques
Sensitivity Analysis: Effect of changes on current optimal settings
Changes in the availability/capacity/demand of resources
Network models and applications: Network modelling and designing networks
Finding the least amount of travel/lines/cables to connect multiple locations
Maximising amount of goods sent between locations
Applications of transport models: Dealing with product supplies and demands in multiple locations
Production scheduling to meet future demands
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — MEng (Hons) Mechanical Engineering (Level 7 / master-level modules)
